traditional: Vitality and authority combined with limitation and structure.

modern.blend: Identity meets limit and discipline. The self is built slowly, under weight, and tested against duty and consequence.
modern.harmonious: Practical, conservative, orderly. Benefits come grudgingly and mostly as stability rather than ease.
modern.hard: A heavy self-concept: difficulty with authority figures, self-doubt, and a chronic sense of falling short. The remedy is steady, useful work.
modern.business: Disciplined and reliable; the risk is self-limiting caution and joyless striving.

cyclicNote: This pair runs a full conjunction-to-conjunction cycle; waxing/waning phase meaning is carried on the transit entries.
